name: Mad Passion
body:
Your mad passion makes you almost impossible to distract.

Prerequisite(s): Must have an insanity or worship the King in Yellow.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on concentration checks. Once per day, you can cast a single spell, use a single bardic performance, or make a single Craft, Knowledge, Perform, or Profession skill check despite one of the following conditions: confused, dazed, dread, fear, fascinated, insanity, stunned.
